generals.name: Liu Bei
generals.title: The Ambitious Leader in Tumultuous Times

skills.name: Benevolence
skills.text: During your action phase, you can give any number of on-hand cards to any other player. If you give three or more on-hand cards away in a single phase, you regain 1 unit of health.

synergisticPartners: Gan Fu Ren (Lady Gan) 甘夫人 (Wife)
generals.differenceFromNormal:
"Benevolence" is weakened. You can only regain health by giving three or more on-hand cards in a single phase, instead of two in Normal SanGuoSha.
His ruler ability is also removed.

generals.name: Elder Zhuge Liang
generals.title: The Prime Minister who has Passed his Prime

skills.name: Star Gazing
skills.text: At the beginning phase of your turn, you can view X cards from the top of the deck (X being the number of players still alive in the game, and cannot exceed 5). Place any number of these cards, in any order, on the top of the deck . Place the remaining cards, in any order, at the bottom of the deck .

skills.name: Empty City
skills.text: An ATTACK 杀 or DUEL 决斗 will be cancelled if you have become the target and you have no cards on-hand.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The ability description for "Empty City" has been changed from “cannot become the target of... ” to “... will be cancelled”. What this means is that you can now target Zhuge Liang and use ATTACK or DUEL on him even if he has no on-hand cards. The ATTACK or DUEL card is simply wasted and has no effect on him. One advantage of this you have one more way to reduce your on-hand cards, especially when you cannot discard anymore cards in your discard phase. This is good in scenarios such as bringing your on-hand cards low enough to avoid Huang Zhong 黄忠's ability, etc. There are many ways to use this to your advantage. Get creative!

generals.name: Younger Zhuge Liang
generals.title: Hidden dragon

skills.name: Eight Trigrams
skills.text: If there is no armour card in your equipped item area, it is viewed as you have EIGHT TRIGRAMS 八卦阵 equipped.

skills.name: Arson
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use a red-suited on-hand card as BLAZE 火攻.

skills.name: Scient
skills.text: You can use a black-suited on-hand card as NEGATE 无懈可击.

synergisticPartners: Pang Tong 庞统 ("Dragon-Phoenix" Combination, Good Friend)
generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Guan Yu
generals.title: The Bearded Gentleman

skills.name: Warrior Saint
skills.text: You can use or play a red-suited card as ATTACK 杀.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Guan Yu has 2.5 units of maximum health instead of 2, differentiating him from other characters with 4 units of maximum health in normal SGS. Another character with this additional health is Lu Bu 吕布. Some joke that they eat their horse, RED HARE 赤兔, to gain an addition 0.5 units of maximum health.

generals.name: Zhang Fei
generals.title: Unstoppable by 10,000 Men

skills.name: Berserk
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use any number of ATTACK 杀.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Huang Yueying
generals.title: The Veiled Heroine

skills.name: Assembling Wisdom
skills.text: When you use a non-time-delay tool card that is not converted from other cards, you can draw a card.

skills.name: Genius
skills.text: There is no distance restriction on tool cards used by you.

synergisticPartners: Elder Zhuge Liang 暮年诸葛亮 (Husband)
Younger Zhuge Liang 卧龙诸葛亮 (Husband)
generals.differenceFromNormal:
“Assembling Wisdom” can only be activated if a non-converted, non-time-delay tool card is used. She cannot draw cards by activating Younger Zhuge Liang's abilities like “Arson 火计”, “Scient 看破” and “Shackle 连环”.
To make this more clear, Huang Yueying can only draw 1 card with her ability if she uses the actual tool card. Eg: If she is partnered with Pang Tong and uses the card "IRON SHACKLES 铁锁链环", she can draw 1 card. But if she uses any other card with the suit of clubs as IRON SHACKLES (Pang Tong's ability), she cannot draw a card.
“Genius” becomes enforced in SGS-KW.

generals.name: Gan Fu Ren (Lady Gan)
generals.title: The Empress of Shining Accomplishments

skills.name: Prudence
skills.text:
Whenever you regain 1 unit of health, you can let another player of your Kingdom to draw 1 card.
(Note: I use "Kingdom" here instead of allegiance. This is because if you are an "Ambitionist 野心家", you are your own kingdom, even though you have other players with the same allegiance as you.)

skills.name: Divine Wisdom
skills.text: At the beginning of your turn, you can discard all your on-hand cards. If by doing so, the number of your discarded cards is not smaller than X, you regain 1 unit of health (X equals to your current health).

generals.differenceFromNormal: She is a brand new character specially created for Kingdom Wars. The initial criticism we had was what a retarded ability she has to give up all her cards. Well, not quite as retarded. She is definitely a support role and can be pretty hard-to-kill. Come on, she only needs to discard ONE card at the start of her turn if she only has 1 unit of health. Then she starts her turn with 2 units of life AND can ask someone else to draw a card. She's much more fun than Zhou Tai 周泰!

generals.name: Huang Zhong
generals.title: Old but Vigorous

skills.name: Fearsome Archer
skills.text:
After selecting a player as the target of your ATTACK 杀 in your action phase, you can disallow this ATTACK 杀 to be responded with DODGE 闪 under the following circumstances:
1. The number of on-hand cards of the target player is greater or equal to your current units of health.
2. The number of on-hand cards of the target player is smaller or equal to your attack range.

synergisticPartners: Wei Yan 魏延 (Colleague since serving Han Xuan 韩玄)
generals.differenceFromNormal: The ability description is slightly changed to clarify the timing to activate “Fearsome Archer”. If you are not a stickler for fine details in wording, the ability is essentially the same.

generals.name: Liu Shan
generals.title: The King with a Laissez-faire Destiny

skills.name: Relish
skills.text: When other player selects you as the target of ATTACK 杀, he/she needs to discard a basic card, or else that ATTACK 杀 has no effect you.

skills.name: Devolution
skills.text: You can skip your action phase, then discard an on-hand card at the end of your turn to give another player an extra turn.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The Ruler Ability is removed.

generals.name: Ma Chao
generals.title: Lone Horseman that Outmatches a Thousand Troops

skills.name: Horsemanship
skills.text: Your distance and range when calculated to other players is always -1.

skills.name: Iron Calvary
skills.text: After selecting a player as the target of your ATTACK 杀, you can make a judgement. If the result is red-suited, the target cannot respond to this ATTACK with DODGE 闪.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The ability description of “Iron Calvary” has been changed from “cannot be evaded” to “cannot respond with DODGE.

generals.name: Meng Huo
generals.title: King of the Southern Barbarians

skills.name: The Smoking Gun
skills.text: BARBARIANS 南蛮入侵 has no effect on you. You are the source of damage caused by BARBARIANS 南蛮入侵.

skills.name: Arise Again
skills.text: During your drawing phase, if you are not at full health, you can forfeit drawing cards from the deck; instead, you display X cards from the top of the deck (X being the units of health you have lost thus far). For every card with hearts suit displayed, you regain 1 unit of health, then you discard those cards and acquire the remaining cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Pang Tong
generals.title: Rising Phoenix

skills.name: Shackle
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use an on-hand card with the suit of clubs as IRON SHACKLES铁索连环, or to re-draw 1 card.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.text: When you are at the Brink of Death, you can discard all of your cards (on-hand and equipped) and all cards in your pending area, then reset your character card such that it is unstacked and unshackled, draw three cards, and regain your health to 3 units.

synergisticPartners: Younger Zhuge Liang 卧龙诸葛亮 ("Dragon-Phoenix" Combination, Good Friend)
generals.differenceFromNormal:
"Shackle" has not been changed. You can still use any number of cards with suits of clubs as IRON SHACKLES.
The ability description of “Resurrection” has been changed, that you can unstack your character cards when you are resurrected.

generals.name: Wei Yan
generals.title: The Blood-thirsty Lone-Wolf

skills.name: Insanity Streak
skills.text: After you inflict 1 unit of damage to a player within physical distance of 1, you regain 1 unit of health.

synergisticPartners: Huang Zhong 黄忠 (Colleague since serving Han Xuan 韩玄)
generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Zhao Yun
generals.title: The Young General

skills.name: Dragon Heart
skills.text: You can use or play your ATTACK 杀 as DODGE 闪, and vice versa.

synergisticPartners: Liu Shan 刘禅 (Rescued at the Battle of Changban)
generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Zhu Rong
generals.title: The Savage Queen

skills.name: Giant Elephant
skills.text: BARBARIANS南蛮入侵 have no effect on you. When any BARBARIANS 南蛮入侵 used by other players is placed into the discard pile after all damage has been resolved, you acquire it.

skills.name: Fearsome Blade
skills.text: Every instance after you inflict damage to your target by using ATTACK杀, you can conduct a Points Duel with that target player. If you win, you acquire a card from that player.

generals.differenceFromNormal: She cannot activate “Fearsome Blade” if she inflicts damage to a player that is not her target. That means she cannot points duel with a player that receives damage by shackling effect, for example.

generals.name: Cao Cao
generals.title: The Militant Emperor of Wei

skills.name: Villainous Hero
skills.text: Every instance after you suffer damage, you can acquire the card that inflicted damage on you.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The term “immediately” is removed to clarify the timing of activating “Villainous Hero”. The Ruler Ability is removed.

generals.name: Cao Pi
generals.title: The Successor of the Domineer

skills.name: Scavenge
skills.text: You can acquire all the cards of players that died.

skills.name: Banish
skills.text: Every instance after you suffer damage, you can make another player draw X cards (X being the units of health you have lost thus far), then that player stacks/unstacks his/her character cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The term “immediately” is removed to clarify the timing of activating “Scavenge”. The ability description of “Banish” has been changed from “flip his/her character card” to “stack/unstack your character card”. The Ruler Ability is removed.

generals.name: Cao Ren
generals.title: The Great General

skills.name: Entrenched
skills.text: At the end phase of your turn, you can draw three cards, then you stack your character cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The ability description of “Entrenched” has been changed from “flip your character card” to “stack your character cards” to reflect the new execution for "skip a turn". Essentially, the ability works the same way.

generals.name: Dian Wei
generals.title: The E-Lai of ancient times

skills.name: Ferocious Assault
skills.text: During your action phase, you can either lose 1 unit of health or discard a weapon card to inflict 1 unit of damage to another player within your attacking range. Limited to once per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Guo Jia
generals.title: The Short-lived Oracle

skills.name: Envy of Heaven
skills.text: After your judgement card takes effect, you can acquire the judgement card.

skills.name: Bequeathed Strategy
skills.text: After every 1 unit of damage you suffer, you can view the top two cards of the deck, give one card to a player, then give the remaining card to a player.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The term “immediately” is removed to clarify the timing of activating “Envy of Heaven”. The ability description of “Bequeathed Strategy” has been changed from “drawing then giving” to “viewing then giving”.

generals.name: Sima Yi
generals.title: The Devil with Eyes behind his Head

skills.name: Retaliation
skills.text: Every instance after you suffer damage, you can acquire a card from the source of damage.

skills.name: Demonic Talent
skills.text: Before the judgement card of a player takes effect, you can play an on-hand card to replace it.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The term “immediately” is removed to clarify the timing of activating “Retaliation”.

generals.name: Xiahou Dun
generals.title: One-eyed Demon

skills.name: An Eye for an Eye
skills.text:
Every instance after you suffer damage, you can flip a judgement card. If the judgment result is not hearts, the source of damage needs to choose between 1 of 2 options:
1. Discard two on-hand cards of his/her choice
2. Receive 1 unit of damage inflicted by you.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Xiahou Yuan
generals.title: Lightning-fast Cheetah

skills.name: Godspeed
skills.text:
You can choose one or both of the following options:
1. Skip your judgement phase and drawing phase.
2. Skip your action phase and discard an equipment card.
Every time you choose one of these options, it is viewed as you using an ATTACK 杀 on another player.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Xu Chu
generals.title: Insane Tiger

skills.name: Bare-Chested
skills.text: During your drawing phase, you can draw one card less so that the damage inflicted by your ATTACK 杀 and DUEL 决斗 (when you are the source of damage) is increased by 1. This effect lasts till the end of your turn.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Xu Huang
generals.title: Reminiscence of Zhou Ya Fu

skills.name: Blockade
skills.text: You can use a black-suited basic card or equipment card as RATIONS DEPLETED 兵粮寸断. You can use RATIONS DEPLETED on other players within the physical distance of 2.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Xun Yu
generals.title: Advisor of Kings

skills.name: Rouse the Tiger
skills.text: During your action phase, you can conduct a Points Duel with a player with more health than you. If you win, that player inflicts 1 unit of damage to another player within his/her attack range of your choice. If you lose, that player inflicts 1 unit of damage to you.

skills.name: Eternal Loyalty
skills.text: After every1 unit of damage you suffer, you can pick a player to replenish on-hand cards such that number of on-hand cards equals his/her maximum health. (Maximum replenishment of 5 cards)

generals.differenceFromNormal: There replenishment for "Eternal Loyalty" has been capped at 5 cards max.

generals.name: Yue Jin
generals.title: Determined to Overcome

skills.name: Dauntless
skills.text: At the ending phase of another player's turn, you can discard a basic card. If you do so, that player needs to discard an equipment card, or else you inflict 1 unit of damage to that player.

generals.differenceFromNormal: This is a brand new character specifically created for Kingdom Wars.

generals.name: Zhang He
generals.title: The Military Clairvoyant

skills.name: Flexibility
skills.text:
You can discard an on-hand card to skip one of your phases (except your beginning phase and your end phase).
If you skip your drawing phase, you acquire an on-hand card from each of a maximum of two players.
If you skip your action phase, you can relocate a card from any player's equipment area/pending area to a corresponding area of another player.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Minor changes in the description for "relocating cards" in his ability. It used to say relocate to a "reasonable area", and it now says "corresponding area".

generals.name: Zhang Liao
generals.title: General of the Front

skills.name: Sudden Strike
skills.text: During your drawing phase, you can forfeit drawing cards from the deck. Instead, you acquire one on-hand card each from one to two other players.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Minor description clarifications, but makes no difference to the usual way he is played.

generals.name: Zhen Ji (Lady Zhen)
generals.title: The ill-Fated Beauty

skills.name: Stunning Beauty
skills.text: You can use or play a black on-hand card as DODGE.

skills.name: Goddess Luo
skills.text: At your beginning of your turn, you can flip a judgement card. If the result is black-suited, you can flip another judgement card, until a red-suited judgement results. After that, you acquire all the black judgement cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: “Goddess Luo” has been changed. You cannot acquire the black cards until the whole process is done. This is to prevent the bug if a player picks Lady Zhen and Sima Yi as a pair.

generals.name: Sun Quan
generals.title: The Young and Virtuous Ruler

skills.name: Balance of Power
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard up to X cards (X being your maximum health units), then draw the same number of cards. Limited to once per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal: “Balance of Power” has been weakened. In a single action phase, he can only discard and draw X cards at most, X being his maximum health. His Ruler Ability is removed.

generals.name: Da Qiao
generals.title: The Preserved Blossom

skills.name: National Beauty
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use a card with the suit of diamonds as ACEDIA 乐不思蜀.

skills.name: Displacement
skills.text: When you become the target of an ATTACK, you can discard an on-hand card to transfer this ATTACK to another player within your attacking range. The receiving player cannot be the same player that used the ATTACK.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Ding Feng
generals.title: The Essential Minister that Purged the King’s Court

skills.name: Close Combat
skills.text: Whenever you use an ATTACK 杀, you can pick one additional player within your physical distance of 1 as the target of the ATTACK.

skills.name: Swift and Deadly
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard a card and select a player. The physical distance between you and that player is viewed as 1 till the end of your turn. Limited to once per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal: He is a brand new character specially created for Kingdom Wars.

generals.name: Gan Ning
generals.title: The Pirate with Silk Sails

skills.name: Surprise Raid
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use a black-suited card as DISMANTLE过河拆桥.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Huang Gai
generals.title: Sacrificing Flesh for his Kingdom

skills.name: Trojan Flesh
skills.text: During your action phase, you can lose 1 unit of health, and then draw two cards.

synergisticPartners: Zhou Yu 周瑜 ("Trojan Flesh" ploy partner)
generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Lu Meng
generals.title: Crossing the River in White Robes

skills.name: Self-Mastery
skills.text: If you have not used or played ATTACK 杀 in your action phase, you can skip your discard phase for this turn.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Lu Su
generals.title: The Maverick Diplomat

skills.name: Altruism
skills.text: When you draw cards during your drawing phase, you can draw two additional cards. If you have more than five on-hand cards as a result, you must give half of your on-hand cards (rounded down to nearest integer) to another player with the smallest number of on-hand cards.

skills.name: Alliance
skills.text: During your action phase, you can choose 2 players (other than yourself) and discard as many cards as the difference between the number of on-hand cards between these 2 players. Then exchange their entire set of on-hand cards. Limited to one use per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Lu Xun
generals.title: The Pillar of Heaven

skills.name: Humility
skills.text: When you become the target of STEAL 顺手牵羊 or ACEDIA 乐不思蜀, these cards are nullified.

skills.name: Scrutinize
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use a red on-hand card as AMASS 以逸待勞.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The ability description for "Humility" has been changed from “cannot become the target of... ” to “... cards are nullified”. “One after another”, his signature ability, has been replaced by “Scrutinize”, which turns Lu Xun from a highly independent character to a support character.

generals.name: Sun Jian
generals.title: The Vigorous Militant Emperor

skills.name: Heroic Spirit
skills.text:
At your beginning phase, if you are not at full health, you can choose between 1 of 2 options:
1. Pick another player to draw X cards, and then discard 1 card.
2. Pick another player to draw 1 card, and then discard X cards.
(X being the units of health you have lost thus far).

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Taishi Ci
generals.title: Ardent and Loyal Warrior

skills.name: Justice of Heaven
skills.text:
During your action phase, you can conduct a Points Duel with another player. If you win, you acquire all of the following until the end of your turn.
1. Your ATTACKS 杀 are not limited by range,
2. You can use one additional ATTACK,
3. You can target one additional player when you use ATTACK.
If you lose, you cannot use ATTACK till the end of the turn. Limited to once per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Sun Shangxiang
generals.title: The Lady with Bow and Arrows

skills.name: Marriage
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard two on-hand cards and choose another player (with combined characters as a male) that is not at full-health. That player and you regain 1 unit of health each. Limited to once per phase.

skills.name: Warrior Lady
skills.text: Every instance you lose equipment cards in your equipped item area, you can draw two cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The description of "Marriage" has been changed. You cannot marry yourself even if you have a male character card as your major character card. “Warrior Lady” has been weakened. The ability description has been changed from “Whenever you lose an equipment card” to “Every instance you lose equipment cards”. That means Sun Shangxiang can only draw two cards when multiple equipped equipments are discarded, e.g. discarding two equipped equipments to activate the ability of ROCK CLEAVING AXE 贯石斧.

generals.name: Xiao Qiao
generals.title: The Unconventional Blossom

skills.name: Heavenly Scent
skills.text: Every instance you receive damage, you can discard an on-hand card with suit of hearts to transfer the damage to another player, then that player draws X cards (X being the units of health that player has lost thus far).

skills.name: Rosy Cheeks
skills.text: Your cards with the suit of spades are viewed as cards with the suit of hearts.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Unfortunately, since she is Zhou Yu's wife, she also suffers hideous disfigurement of her portrait. Otherwise, she is unchanged.

generals.name: Zhang Zhao & Zhang Hong
generals.title: Talents to administrate Heaven and Earth

skills.name: Blunt advice
skills.text: During your action phase, you can place an on-hand equipment card into the equipped item area of another player, and then you draw a card.

skills.name: Stabilization
skills.text: At the end of other players’ discard phase, you can return a card that was discarded in this phase from the discard pile to that player. If you do so, you can acquire all other cards discarded in this player's discard phase from the discard pile.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Zhou Tai
generals.title: Body Scarred like a Battle Record

skills.name: Refuting Death
skills.text: Whenever your health is reduced by 1 unit while your current unit of health is 0, you can reveal a card from the top of the deck and place it onto your character card. As long as none of these cards have the same number (Ace thru King) displayed, you do not die. If a card is revealed with the same point as another existing card, you enter the Brink of Death.

generals.differenceFromNormal: Nil.

generals.name: Zhou Yu
generals.title: Commander-in-Chief

skills.name: Heroic Demeanor
skills.text: When you draw cards during your drawing phase, you can draw one additional card.

skills.name: Sow Dissension
skills.text: During your action phase, you can choose another player to pick a suit. This player then acquires one of your on-hand cards and reveals it to everyone. If the suit of the acquired card is different from the suit he/she had chosen, you cause 1 unit of damage to that player. Limited to once per phase.

generals.differenceFromNormal:
“Sow Dissension” has been changed such that the victim acquires the on-hand card before receiving damage. Zhou Yu cannot get back the card if he kills another player by “Sow Dissension”.
But the really obvious difference is Zhou Yu's unbelievably hideous portrait. What in the world were they thinking?!?!

generals.name: Yuan Shao
generals.title: Aristocratic Ancestry

skills.name: Barrage
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use two on-hand cards with the same suit as RAINING ARROWS 万箭齐发.

synergisticPartners: Yan Liang & Wen Chou 颜良&文丑 (Most trusted Generals)
generals.differenceFromNormal: The Ruler Ability is removed. Other than that, he is identical to SGS.

generals.name: Zhang Jiao
generals.title: General of Heaven

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.text: Whenever you use or play a DODGE 闪, you can select another player to make a judgement. If the result is the suit of spades, you inflict 2 units of lightning damage to that player.

skills.name: Dark Sorcery
skills.text: Before the judgement card of a player takes effect, you can interchange that judgement card with a black-suited card.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The Ruler Ability is removed. Otherwise, Zhang Jiao is the same!

generals.name: Lu Bu
generals.title: Ultimate Combat Skills - Personified

skills.name: Without Equal
skills.text: After selecting a player as the target of your ATTACK 杀, the target of your ATTACK need to use two DODGE 闪 successively to neutralize your ATTACK. During a DUEL 决斗, your opponent needs to play two ATTACKS successively each time.

generals.differenceFromNormal:
Lu Bu has 2.5 units of maximum health instead of 2, differentiating him from other characters with 4 units of maximum health in normal SGS. Another character with this additional health is Guan Yu 关羽. Some joke that they eat their horse, RED HARE 赤兔, to gain an addition 0.5 units of maximum health.
The description of “Without Equal” is slightly changed to clarify the timing of activation.
In general, Lu Bu is unchanged from the original SGS.

generals.name: Diao Chan
generals.title: The Dancer with Unrivaled Beauty

skills.name: Seed of Animosity
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard a card and select two other male characters. It is then viewed as one of the players used a DUEL 决斗 on the other player. This DUEL cannot be responded to with NEGATE 无懈可击. Limited to once per phase.

skills.name: Envious Moon
skills.text: At your end phase, you can draw a card.

generals.differenceFromNormal: The description of "Seed of Animosity" has been modified such that you cannot use it on yourself even if you have a male character card as your major character card. Note that the gender of the victims is based on the main character if both are exposed, or based on the only exposed character. But otherwise, this character is unchanged from SGS.

generals.name: Cai Wen Ji (Lady Cai)
generals.title: The Lone Dame in Foreign Lands

skills.name: Dirge
skills.text:
Every instance after a player suffers damage from ATTACK, you can discard a card and let that player make a judgement. If the result is:
Hearts: the victim regains 1 unit of health.
Diamonds: the victim draws two cards.
Clubs: the attacker discards two cards.
Spades: the attacker stacks his/her character cards.

skills.name: Sorrow
skills.text: When you die, you cause the player who kills you to lose all the abilities of one of his/her character cards.

generals.differenceFromNormal: “Sorrow” has been changed such that the killer only loses the abilities on one of his/her character card.

generals.name: Hua Tuo
generals.title: The Miracle Physician

skills.name: First Aid
skills.text: Outside of your turn, you can use a red-suited card as PEACH 桃.
